AHI 203PA-630, Small Square Surface Mount Rose

This is a 2 inch Square Stainless Steel Roses. Surface mounted, screws to the doors face.

Features and Specifications of the 50MM Square Rosette:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Length: 50 MM (square)
  • Thickness: 11 MM ( .440" )
  • Mounting: Surface Mounted

Sold Individually with mounting screws

Special Ordered Item, NOT Returnable
